name: paytrail/paytrail-for-woocommerce
description: Paytrail is a payment gateway that offers 20+ payment methods for Finnish customers.

scripts.lint:changes: git diff --name-only HEAD~1 | grep '\.php$' | xargs -r vendor/bin/phpcs --standard=phpcs.xml --extensions=php -q
scripts.lint:fix:changes: git diff --name-only HEAD~1 | grep '\.php$' | xargs -r vendor/bin/phpcbf --standard=phpcs.xml --extensions=php -q

scripts-descriptions.test:bootstrap: Set up the local test WP install: scaffold core, configure it against SQLite, install WP, place the SQLite drop-in and copy tests/_mu-plugins/. Idempotent, and a no-op without the dev dependencies.
scripts-descriptions.test:setup: Bootstrap the test env and regenerate the Codeception Actor classes. Called by the test:* scripts.
scripts-descriptions.test:integration: Run the Integration suite. Shares the SQLite database with test:harness, so never run the two at once.
scripts-descriptions.test:integration:snapshots: Rewrite the request fixtures in tests/Support/Data/snapshots/ from what the plugin currently sends, then review the diff. Run after an intended change to a Paytrail payload.
scripts-descriptions.test:harness: Run the tests covering the harness itself rather than the plugin. Shares the SQLite database with test:integration.
scripts-descriptions.test:report: Render the Allure report from whichever suite results are present into tests/_output/report/.
scripts-descriptions.test:report:share: Same, but one self-contained tests/_output/report-share/index.html for sharing.
scripts-descriptions.test:report:reset: Delete all accumulated Allure results and rendered reports.
scripts-descriptions.test:chromedriver: Download a Chromedriver build matching the local Chrome. Run once after a Chrome update if E2E tests start failing with a "session not created" driver mismatch.
scripts-descriptions.test:e2e: Run the EndToEnd suite. Needs NGROK_DOMAIN, NGROK_AUTHTOKEN and PAYTRAIL_WORDPRESS_URL in tests/.env, plus a generated tests/Support/Data/dump.sql.
scripts-descriptions.test:regenerate-dump: Rebuild tests/Support/Data/dump.sql from a clean WP + WooCommerce + plugin install. Run after upstream changes that affect the baseline schema or options.
scripts-descriptions.phpstan: Run PHPStan static analysis with a 2G memory limit.
scripts-descriptions.phpstan:baseline: Generate a PHPStan baseline with a 2G memory limit.
